task.prompt:
CONTEXT:
Work in {project_root} on {date}. V719 wrote nine producer primaries and three conductor pre-gate receipts; two producer slots have neither. Static heads and reserved predictions qualified (Exp8334/8335). Local qualification failed three Exp8206 consumer assertions; runtime failed two Exp8307 authority assertions; ARC failed strict typing; cost consumers failed three Exp8329 assertions. GateMate history drifted. The capstone passed its memory checks but failed two branch replays. H1/H2 remain unmeasured. Preserve the frozen V717 science and historical outcomes. Cached observations are exposed development, not current model inference.
EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v719-preserved-20261009.md; openspec/change-proposals/v717-local-learning-protocol.json; results/experiment_8345_v719_capstone.json; python/carnot/reporting/v719_capstone.py; python/carnot/reporting/v719_capstone_evidence.py; python/carnot/reporting/v719_capstone_reduction.py; python/carnot/reporting/arc_supervisor_frontier_8342.py; python/carnot/reporting/gatemate_change_ledger_8344.py
TASK:
Qualify branch replay against immutable producer source closures. Deliver results/experiment_8358_v720_terminal_replay_qualification.json. Create the thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8358_v720_terminal_replay_qualification.py. Store primitive evidence under results/raw/experiment_8358_v720_terminal_replay_qualification/. Future deliverables are dependencies, not existing inputs.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Emit a flushed start line. Authenticate source bytes, terminal sidecars and task authority. Check private scratch, tools and resources before work. Name missing external operands in gate_check_summary. Do not replace natural evidence with fixtures.
2. Emit a flushed progress line at every phase boundary. Emit one before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess. Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Use unbuffered output and bounded deadlines. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write files over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. No single huge tool call. Do not pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Preserve assertions, guard thresholds and old evidence. Keep scratch in /tmp and runners in scripts/experiments/. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml. Freeze validation commands before measurement.
4. Declare no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current model calls. Identify cached verifier work or artifact aggregation as the inference_substrate. Training small numeric heads is not an LLM load.
5. Read Exp8345 branch_replay_receipts. Memory and ordinary validation passed; branch_8342_replay returned false and branch_8344_replay reported a changed source hash. Bind the exact failed argv, source bytes and first mismatched operand. Do not misdiagnose this as the previously fixed memory guard.
6. Reuse existing parameterized readers and publisher. Snapshot source/configuration closures before measurement and freeze them through publication. Validate both an authenticated disqualified producer and a successful private producer. Reader success means the recorded failed disposition replays exactly, never scientific promotion. If original source closure is unavailable, record authenticated-history-unavailable and preserve the failed artifact.
7. Qualify current Exp8355/8357 replay adapters if those outputs exist; their scientific/physical blocks must replay honestly. A missing current producer is external blocked, not partial. Current schema or replay code failure is disqualified. No structured gate suppresses this diagnostic. Avoid executing arbitrary unverified historical code; authenticate the captured closure and use bounded private children.
8. Run valid, missing-source, changed-source, wrong-authority, changed-disposition and self-consistently rehashed tamper cases using real child CLIs. Require matching primitive reductions and zero mutable-vNEXT dependence. Preserve the established memory watchdog and measure parent/child RSS. Write docs/research-notes/v720-replay-qualification.md. Run private E2E-018/021.
9. Set branch_replay_ready_score only when owned adapters and controls qualify. Publish compact source references instead of recursively copying nested artifacts. Retain historical disqualifications and missing closure diagnostics verbatim. Do not modify research_conductor.py, adversarial_verify.py or primary_publication.py.
10. Run relevant unit and consumer tests, scoped Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private scratch. Record argv, exit, timing and log hashes. Do not run the full repository suite inside this experiment.
11. Cold-replay primitive evidence in a fresh process. Run valid, negative and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Use unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep all findings. An exit1 requires the existing typed finding consumer: only independently recomputed informational findings with deliberate-error controls can resolve. Errors, unknown severity, warnings and critical findings block readiness. Do not edit those validators or exemption lists. Publish the terminal primary atomically after checks. Owned failures are disqualified; unchanged external blocks are blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind the invocation to its exact authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: honest_verdict starts complete_. Class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Partial means retryable unfinished owned work only.
gate_check_summary: principle: A block names upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed values. Missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Separate current work from imported inference.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Retain every intended unit and condition. Repeated timings do not add independent sources.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle controls use circular_positive. Both generalization scores remain zero on exposed development.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Readiness requires byte-bound checks, not scientific success.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Bind claims to measured work and replayable inputs.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported evidence and explain every added field.
branch_replay_ready_score, branch_replay_receipts, first_mismatch, source_closure_manifest, historical_dispositions: principle: Reproducible failure is distinct from promoted success.
parent_child_memory_rows, mutable_authority_access_count: principle: Replay must not hide memory growth or depend on current historical aliases.
Run command: cd {project_root} && PYTHONPATH=python:. PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_8358_v720_terminal_replay_qualification.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
